preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200000.
The product of N and M for each test case must be between 2 and 500000.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i][j] in {'.', '#'} for i in range(N) for j in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must contain either '.' or '#', representing empty or wall cells respectively.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of airstrikes required for each test case.
